name: Moroccan Sardine "Meatball" Sandwich (Hout Quari) with Spiced Tomato Sauce, Olives, Cilantro & Onions

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Roughly chop tomatoes. Place in a food processor.

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add 1/3 to the food processor, along with oil and spices. Pulse on high, scraping down the sides of the processor as needed, until tomato sauce is finely chopped, 30-60 seconds. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining cilantro and food processor for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain sardines, then add to the food processor along with 1/3 of the cilantro (reserving the last 1/3 for serving), bread crumbs, oil, and spices. Pulse on high, scraping down the sides of the processor as needed, until the mixture is paste-like in consistency, 1-2 minutes. Using a generous rounded tablespoon measure, form the fish mixture into meatballs and place on a plate (you should have 18 meatballs).
instructions.secondary_message:
4 (3.75 oz) pkg sardines (packed in water)
2 tbsp panko bread crumbs
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp garam masala
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning frequently, until golden brown and warmed through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, drain olives, then slice crosswise into thin pieces. Place on a clean plate.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the olives.
Cut lemon into wedges. Add to the plate and set aside.
Fill each roll with 3 meatballs, then top with spiced tomato sauce, sliced olives, onion, and reserved  cilantro. Divide between plates and serve with lemon wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
